data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ἓν, hen means 'one' or 'single'. In Christian tradition, the name Hen symbolizes unity, oneness with God, and the sacrifice of Christ who became one with humanity. The name Hen carries the meaning “Chicken, young rooster” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hen usually hope their child will grow to embody chicken, young rooster and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
